title: Set Up a GitOps Demo with ArgoCD
description: Install ArgoCD and deploy a sample app from a Git repository.
problemStatement:
## 🎯 Goal
Install ArgoCD on your cluster, then create an Application that syncs a sample nginx deployment from a Git repository (use the ArgoCD example repo).

### Prerequisites
- A Kubernetes cluster (minikube/kind) with enough resources.
- kubectl configured.

### Steps
1. Create the namespace and install ArgoCD:
   ```bash
   kubectl create namespace argocd
   kubectl apply -n argocd -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/stable/manifests/install.yaml
   ```
2. Wait for all ArgoCD pods to be ready: `kubectl get pods -n argocd -w`.
3. Access the ArgoCD UI via port‑forward:
   ```bash
   kubectl port-forward svc/argocd-server -n argocd 8080:443
   ```
4. Get the admin password:
   ```bash
   kubectl -n argocd get secret argocd-initial-admin-secret -o jsonpath="{.data.password}" | base64 -d
   ```
5. Log in to the UI (https://localhost:8080) with admin / password (ignore TLS warning).
6. Now, create an Application that deploys a sample nginx app from the ArgoCD example repo:
   - Use a YAML file `argocd-app.yaml` or create via CLI. We'll use CLI:
   ```bash
   argocd login localhost:8080 --username admin --password <password> --insecure
   argocd app create nginx-demo \
     --repo https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps.git \
     --path guestbook \
     --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc \
     --dest-namespace default
   ```
   (Alternatively, apply a YAML Application resource)
7. Sync the app: `argocd app sync nginx-demo`.
8. In the UI, verify the application becomes Healthy and Synced.
9. Check that the guestbook pods are running: `kubectl get pods -n default`.
10. Clean up: delete the application and optionally the ArgoCD installation.
hints: The ArgoCD example repo has a `guestbook` directory with a Deployment and Service; it's a good starter.

If `argocd` CLI not installed, you can use `kubectl apply -f` with an Application YAML. Use `kubectl apply -f -` with the following Application spec: https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/getting_started/#creating-apps-via-cli (or generate YAML via CLI with --dry-run).
expectedOutput: ArgoCD UI shows a synced and healthy nginx application, Pods running.
solutionCode:
kubectl create namespace argocd
kubectl apply -n argocd -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/stable/manifests/install.yaml
# wait...
argocd login localhost:8080 --username admin --password $(kubectl -n argocd get secret argocd-initial-admin-secret -o jsonpath="{.data.password}" | base64 -d) --insecure
argocd app create nginx-demo --repo https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps.git --path guestbook --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default
argocd app sync nginx-demo
